name: Vigorous Brushstrokes
description: You bump into a painter who offers free souvenir paintings for tourists in Liyue Harbor...

dialogs.content: Hmm... Something feels missing from this painting. Maybe I need a bit more inspiration...
#Wow, look who it is! {NICKNAME}, I've heard so much about you — what an honor to finally meet you.
As you can see, I'm setting up a festival venue following the plans from the Ministry of Civil Affairs.
Umm... Are you gonna teach others to draw?
Ah, not quite! Instead of "teaching others to draw," I am going to "draw for others."
As the Lantern Rite grows bigger each year, more and more people come to join in, and many of them are tourists from faraway lands.
Although the Ministry of Civil Affairs offers complimentary souvenir photos, that still doesn't quite embody the spirit of Liyue.
That's why they sent me here — to create hand-drawn souvenirs for the visitors.
I noticed that the legend of the "White Horse Adeptus" is pretty well-known around Liyue Harbor, so I figured it'd make a great theme for a drawing.

You know how the saying goes: vibrant as dragons, spirited as steeds. So really, what's more auspicious than a "flying gallop" painting with a white horse? It's got that same bold, uplifting energy people associate with dragons and tigers.
#What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Got any ideas for a drawing?
Well, I have quite a lot...
Oh? Hahaha, great! Just tell me your idea, and I'll make it happen.
